# LUSH Cosmetics & Jewelleries

> Beauty, cosmetics, fragrance, 18K gold-plated jewellery, and gift shop located in Mahawewa, Sri Lanka, offering walk-in shopping and island-wide delivery across Sri Lanka.

## What We Sell
LUSH Cosmetics & Jewelleries retails skincare, facial and body care products, perfumes and body sprays, 18K gold-plated imitation jewellery (chains, pendants, bangles, and earrings), plush teddy bears, plush backpacks, imported chocolates, birthday party decorations and hampers, Valentine's and anniversary keepsake gifts, makeup brushes and tools, hair accessories, and leather wallets.

## Product Categories
- **Cosmetics & Skincare**: Face serums, day and night creams, facial cleansers, toners, scrubs, face masques, body washes, body lotions, body oils, shampoos, conditioners, and hair oils (brands include BioAqua, Bio Glow, Carotone, Dove, Dr. Rashel, Garnier, Jovees, La Fresh, St. Ives, The Elf, TRESemmé, Vaseline, Vatika, Viana, XHC, YC, and Lush Exclusive).
- **Perfumes & Sprays**: Eau de Parfum and Eau de Toilette fragrances (including Maison de Parfum, Royal Amber, and Regazza Femme).
- **Gold-Plated Jewellery**: 18K gold-plated filigree earrings, curb and Figaro neck chains, crystal-studded pendants, and bangle sets.
- **Teddy Bears & Gifts**: Giant plush teddy bears, character plush toys (Stitch, Winnie the Pooh), plush fur backpacks and crossbody bags, and crystal rose ornaments.
- **Valentine's & Lovers**: Rose bouquets, romantic couple figurines, LOVE table decor, LED heart photo frames, and Valentine's gift packs.
- **Birthday Party**: Birthday party decoration packs (balloons, banners, candles, hats) and gift-wrapped birthday hampers.
- **Chocolates**: Imported chocolates and gift boxes (including Toblerone, Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk, KitKat, and Snickers).
- **Makeup Tools**: 12-piece rose gold makeup brush sets and waterproof liquid eyeliner pens.
- **Hair & Accessories**: Boar bristle paddle hair brushes, claw clips, snap clips, and pearl pins.
- **Wallets & Bags**: Ladies' leather tri-fold wallets and men's RFID-blocking slim bifold wallets.

## Opening Hours (Sri Lanka Standard Time, UTC+05:30)
- **Monday – Friday**: 8:30 AM – 8:00 PM (08:30–20:00)
- **Saturday – Sunday**: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM (09:00–21:00)
- In-store walk-ins welcome; on-site parking available.

## Ordering, Delivery & Payment Options
- **How to Order**: Orders placed on the website open directly in WhatsApp (+94 76 454 6167) with the customer's name, phone number, delivery address, itemised quantities and prices, and total in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR / Rs.).
- **Delivery Options**:
  - Islandwide courier delivery across Sri Lanka
  - Express delivery
  - Free in-store pickup at the Mahawewa shop
- **Payment Options**:
  - **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Pay in cash upon delivery.
  - **Bank Transfer**: Direct bank transfer (Commercial Bank / Sampath / HNB).
  - **PayHere / Koko / Mintpay**: Pay on confirmation — a payment link is sent via WhatsApp after order confirmation.
